dct_title_s: Map of the Minneapolis Union Railway from University Switch to junction with St. Paul Minneapolis and Manitoba Railway, scale 1 inch = 50 feet, February 12, 1883
dct_alternative_sm: Map of the Minneapolis Union Railway from University Switch to junction with St. Paul Minneapolis and Manitoba Railway, scale 1 inch = 50 feet, February 12, 1883
dct_description_sm: Oriented with north towards the upper left.; Shows Minneapolis Mill Pond, Upton's Island, Hennepin Island, and Stone Arch Bridge.; "This map is made for the City of Minneapolis in Section 14 of 'an ordinance granting to the Minneapolis Union Railway Company the right to construct and operate Lines of Railway upon and across certain Streets of the City of Minneapolis.' Passed January 12th 1883. [Signed] Chas. C. Smith, Chief Eng."; Library's copy has "Drawing no. 128. City Engineer's Office. Vault no. 1, Case no. 1, Drawer no. A1." stamped on verso.; Library's copy has "T181-2." iInscribed in red pencil on verso.; Library's copy has "#500" inscribed in red pencil on verso.
